newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P says rates AES China Generating notes BB-minus.
newsitem.headline: S&P says rates AES China Generating notes BB-minus.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp said on Friday it assigned its BB-minus rating to AES China Generating Co Ltd's US$180 million senior unsecured notes due in the year 2006.
AES China Generating is a unit of AES Corp, a power company.

Beijing-based AES China Generating develops, finances, owns and operates power generation facilities in China, with equity interests in eight projects and one additional project in advanced development.

S&P said the rating reflected a high degree of construction risk of the company's project portfolio, with six projects not yet completed. The company also operates within a dynamic and emerging regulatory and legal framework that lacks transparency.
Offsetting the risks, AES China Generating's prospective financial profile is strong for the rating category, S&P said.
The company also enjoys the support of parent AES Corp, although the rating of AES China Generating is not directly supported by the BB rating of AES Corp, S&P said.
The rating outlook is stable, S&P added.
